Environment models (buildings and props) generated for Tablefolk with Meshy 7.1
image-to-3D and multi-image-to-3D (through fal.ai), 2026-11, from the project's
own concept art: crops of the approved style scenes, isolated with FLUX Kontext
(fal-ai/flux-pro/kontext), back views of the buildings with nano-banana-pro edit.
Paid generations owned by the project, like the Meshy people and monsters in
assets/models/characters/meshy/; released with the project under the repo's
asset licence (README.md, "Licence").

Processed in Blender (ground discs and stray bits removed, origin at the centre
of the footprint on the ground, front/door toward +Z, scaled to metres,
decimated) and compressed with tools/compress-glb.sh: <name>.glb has 2048 px
textures (--max 2048), <name>.1k.glb 1024 px. manifest.json lists every model,
its footprint, height, front side and the pack.json type it replaces.
